s3.ptxt: Disconnect the stop light switch connector.
Loosen the clevis lock nut, and turn the push rod to adjust the pedal height.
Insert the stop light switch into the adjuster until the stop light switch contacts the brake pedal.

item.ptxt: Do not push in the brake pedal when inserting the stop light switch.
Perform the work while supporting the brake pedal so that it is pulled up.
